answer: Layered-stratum identity: every agent keeps an append-only sediment record, like shale. Each epoch, peers co-sign one new stratum of its real transaction history, and weight grows only with depth. Each round the ledger samples a random kernel from an old stratum and demands the agent recompute it as a live signal; clones sharing one operator emit correlated timings and collapse into a single paying identity. Forging depth takes years of verifiable counterparty work, so a sybil farm sinks capital into thousands of keys that never surface a second reward.
